title: Prime-power Diophantine tuples
summary: A positive $D(n)$-$m$-tuple is a set $A=\{a_1,\ldots,a_m\}$ of distinct positive integers such that $a_i a_j+n$ is a square for every $i\ne j$. In 2005, Dujella and Luca obtained an absolute bound for the cardinality of a $D(p)$- or $D(-p)$-tuple of positive integers, uniformly in the prime $p$. We extend the underlying gap argument to prime powers. An explicit toric elimination certificate, proved by elementary linear algebra, replaces the unsaturated homogeneous elimination step and is valid modulo every prime power.
